sentences.text: Adapala Madhava Rao Madhava, vs The State Of Andhra

Author: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
Bench: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 Criminal Petition No.4188 Of 2020
Order:

This petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, to quash the F.I.R No.203 of 2020 on the file of Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 420, 270, 273 IPC and Sections 57(1), 58 and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. Though the petitioners raised several contentions in the petition, during the hearing, learned counsel for the petitioners and the Additional Public Prosecutor fairly conceded that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by an earlier order passed by this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018.

3. Recording the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioners and the Additional Public Prosecutor, this Criminal Petition is allowed quashing the F.I.R No.203 of 2020 on the file of Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District in terms of the said order.

Miscellaneous Petitions, if any pending, in this Criminal Petition, shall stand closed.
